long_biography.plain_text:
Doug Barnes had already launched Vision Express and sold it to Pearle Vision three years later when he opened the first Eyemart Express shop in Appleton, Wisconsin. This second venture paired an everyday-low-price model with laboratories inside stores, allowing many prescriptions to be filled within an hour.

Barnes studied business at Western Kentucky University before receiving his optometry doctorate from the University of Houston. He and his wife, Molly, later pledged $5 million to his alma mater, which named its clinical and research Vision Institute for them. The centre added an ambulatory surgery facility, research laboratories and teaching spaces for optometry students and practitioners.
